label: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE (Fixture Co): underpriced scoped brief for Client A's multilingual donate page.

qualification.problem: Donors on phones abandon the current donate page; it only exists in English and fails keyboard use.
qualification.fit: Matches the web-agency-delivery service in the Fixture Co catalogue.

outcomes: A donate page in English, Spanish and Arabic that works by keyboard and screen reader
A support handoff the client's operator can run without the agency
scope: One donate page template with three locales
Support runbook and operator training notes
exclusions: Linguistic review of translations (the client's language reviewer owns it)
assumptions: The client supplies reviewed source copy in English
The client's hosting provider accepts static HTML and CSS

acceptance.criterion: Keyboard users reach and operate every control with visible focus
acceptance.evidence: agency-keyboard-audit pass on every locale page

acceptance.criterion: No placeholder, plural, untranslated or RTL layout defects
acceptance.evidence: agency-i18n-check pass on es and ar catalogs with the page template and CSS
